about: Server plugins EasyServer can install. Each one belongs to its author - EasyServer only downloads it from the author's own GitHub page. Want yours listed? Open a pull request that adds it here.

plugins.name: CareerMP
plugins.author: StanleyDudek
plugins.about: BeamNG.drive's own Career Mode on your server. Saves stay on each player's PC.
notes: Needs MaxCars 100 or more and the West Coast USA map.
Its README says it doesn't work with BeamNG.drive 0.39 yet - check before installing.

plugins.name: freeRoamMP
plugins.author: StanleyDudek
plugins.about: The game's Freeroam mode with missions: deliveries, police, stunts.
notes: Some missions spawn many objects - set a high MaxCars.
Its README says it doesn't work with BeamNG.drive 0.39 yet - check before installing.

plugins.name: BeamMP Environment Sync
plugins.author: Evan Mulawski
plugins.about: Everyone sees the same time of day and weather, set by the server.
notes: Work in progress, says its author.

plugins.name: CobaltEssentials
plugins.author: Preston Elam (CobaltTetra), maintained by StanleyDudek
plugins.about: The classic admin toolkit: permission groups, commands, RCON.
notes: It has its own admins, bans and commands - they overlap with EasyServer's Moderation page. Use one or the other.
After installing, type "ce setgroup YourName owner" in the server console.
plugins.license: All rights reserved by the author - downloaded from their page, not shipped with EasyServer

plugins.name: BeamJoy Sandbox (Revived)
plugins.author: Samaël (my-name-is-samael), continued by CaptainNugget
plugins.about: All-in-one sandbox framework with an in-game admin menu, updated for BeamNG.drive 0.39.
notes: Remove any other BeamJoy version first - they don't mix.
It has its own admin system - it overlaps with EasyServer's Moderation page.
